Payment readiness

payment can be discussed only after minimum commercial, bank and technical evidence is visible

EVIDENCE PACKET
PI snapshot, bank check note, material / pressure evidence, open item delta-list

ESCALATION OWNER
WinGPro decision owner
STATUS CONTROL
owner required until payment evidence is complete enough for WinGPro review
